''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the zero point of the [[Unidentified calendar (Ruusan Reformation)|calendar]] introduced by [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] was the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]]. The book places that event in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]&mdash;which was based around the date of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]&mdash;therefore establishing a difference of [[Millennium/Legends|one thousand years]] between the two dating systems.<noinclude>
